purpose: Source-lock-bound Track A accounting matrix. Every retained Jira source operation remains visible with seven lane cells; no mapping is executable without separate proof.

disposition_vocabulary.implemented: Executable runtime evidence exists. Track A intentionally uses none.
disposition_vocabulary.mapped_unproven: A source-backed mapping exists, but Track A makes no executable runtime claim.
disposition_vocabulary.missing_foundation: A source-backed cell needs a named shared capability that Track A does not implement.
disposition_vocabulary.not_applicable: No retained source fact satisfies this matrix lane candidate rule.

mapping_policy.source_authority: Only sources/jira-operation-source-lock.json supplies provider facts for this matrix.
mapping_policy.direct_read: A source operation is a direct-read candidate when its retained provider semantics document a bounded read. GET remains a source fact, and the cited POST read inventory covers provider searches, evaluations, validations, previews, and bulk fetches; neither method alone is runtime proof.
mapping_policy.direct_write_and_reverse_etl: Every retained provider mutation, including DELETE, is mapped independently to direct_write and reverse_etl. Source-cited POST reads are excluded from those mutation lanes; this is source accounting only, not executable runtime proof.
mapping_policy.binary: Binary candidates require the exact locked media and, for wildcard avatar uploads, the cited locked image text; no general media-type inference is used.
mapping_policy.etl: A source-read operation is an ETL candidate only when retained provider facts document continuation: offset, cursor, response nextPage/link, or cited request-body continuation. maxResults alone is a limit annotation, not an ETL admission. Existing streams.json rows remain backlinks only; all remaining candidates require source-preserving typed stream projection before ETL through DuckDB can be proven.
mapping_policy.sync_transport: Only registerDynamicWebhooks documents a destination url and selected webhooks[].events. Its inbound receiver and DuckDB-mediated registered source remain a typed missing foundation.

source_boundary_reconciliation.reason: The current Jira crosswalk is exact 617-to-617 method/path reconciliation. It is a backlink audit, not provider-fact authority.

legacy_etl_reconciliation.source_paging_candidate_criterion: source-read operation with retained continuation evidence
legacy_etl_reconciliation.execution_boundary: The three legacy streams are not promoted to implemented. The wider source paging cohort stays mapped_unproven pending independently proven projection, execution, and certification.

sync_actual_gap.missing_capability: closed inbound Jira webhook receiver and DuckDB-mediated registered source executor
sync_actual_gap.proof_test_idea: Validate a source-scoped delivery, a rejected unauthenticated or duplicate delivery, durable DuckDB warehouse acknowledgement, and replay/conformance behavior.
